notes: INCOMPLETE PROJECT MANIFEST: the accepted source cannot express the approved full vault deployment under the unique-contract-name rule. This manifest describes only LaunchToken, PriceFeed and NhiFeed; it is not a complete launch plan for the approved liquidation increment. BLOCKING SOURCE FINDING: the approved workflow requires separate primary-average, NHI and spot feeds, but the accepted tree provides only concrete PriceFeed and NhiFeed; SwarmFeed is abstract. The deployment script creates PriceFeed twice, which cannot be represented by unique manifest contract identifiers. A separately named concrete spot-feed artifact and its ABI are needed from the source contribution before CDPVault can be included after all three feeds. Reusing the primary as spot defeats the approved divergence guard; substituting a legacy feed is not approved. CDPVault is therefore omitted rather than supplied an incorrect spot dependency. Its accepted constructor order is imdToken, compToken, oracle, priceFeed, nhiFeed, spotFeed, maxDivergenceBps, markerShareBps, stabilityFeeBps. The approved inputs are existing Sepolia MockIMD 0xe44ab81ce23d34e29383dd158a1dffeb1c10d439, zero, zero, the new primary feed, the new NHI feed, a distinct new spot feed, 500, 1000, 0. MockIMD must not be redeployed. The zero CompToken and oracle arguments would create and permanently bind those children within the vault constructor without initialization calls. LaunchToken is COMP Launch (CPL), separate from the vault's elastic CompToken. Both listed feeds use the approved attester, policy-resolved $owner as sole relayer and reporter, payload chainId 1, answerType 3, quorum 1, maxAge 86400 and maxDeviationBps 2000. Feeds open unseeded. The consumer domain uses the deployment chain and each feed address. AUTHORIZATION REVIEW: $owner resolves exclusively from policy and is intended to match the workflow-approved relayer/reporter; this manifest does not authorize a replacement operator. Source also pins mock-faucet authority and FEE_RECIPIENT rather than deriving them from policy, requiring independent authorization review. FEE_RECIPIENT equals the approved reporter/relayer; stabilityFeeBps and the protocol bonus share are zero in this release. Deployment scope is Sepolia (11155111); chain selection belongs to services. The pool pairs CPL with native ETH using fee 3000, tickSpacing 60 and decimal sqrtPriceX96 initialPrice. The factory supplies the LP, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only PoolInitializationGuard. Notes grant no deployment authority. Services own policy, source publication, signed artifact linkage, attestation, admission, deployment and frontend startup; unresolved source and authorization findings require review before full launch.
